description: Testbenches shipped for T1 item 9. The cocotb stream bench (test_fft256_stream.py) drives the streaming wrapper over the generated core and checks it bit-exactly against the bit-accurate model, plus handshake, back-pressure, reset mid-frame and zero model overflow, with a negative control (fft-bench-negctl). The remaining listed benches are the existing item 9 evidence: the model and reference tests, the generated-core smoke, and the wrapper smoke. cold_start runs every bench and negative control from a venv built from verification/requirements.txt (see verification/README.md); it is local_only because it needs Icarus, so the signoff.yml runner skips it under --check and re-verifies the recorded hashes.
